_about: The outcome check's controls (owner, 2026-10-16). thermopylae is ref 194 as dropped on Oct 16 (drop 61): the positive control. custer is held out (never in the prompt) and must flag; miracle_on_ice must not. tests/test_arsenal.py locks the prompt and the page ranking with these; scripts.arsenal_outcome_control runs them through the real model.

card.title: Thermopylae
card.origin: In 480 BC, Leonidas I led a Greek alliance, including 300 Spartans, holding the pass at Thermopylae against Xerxes' Persian army for three days.
card.meaning: Chose terrain and a narrow front so a smaller force could hold against a vastly larger one.
card.deploy_line: I'm not fighting them across the whole market, I'm holding one narrow pass where our numbers don't matter.

card.title: Custer's Last Stand
card.origin: At the Little Bighorn in 1876, Custer split his 7th Cavalry and charged a far larger Lakota and Cheyenne force.
card.meaning: Move first and hit hard before the other side organizes.
card.deploy_line: We charge first, before they're organized, and the bigger side folds.

card.title: Miracle on Ice
card.origin: At Lake Placid in 1980, a team of US college players beat the Soviet Union 4-3.
card.meaning: The underdog can beat the favorite on the day.
card.deploy_line: They're the favorite on paper, and that's exactly how the Soviets felt in 1980.
